name: Essential Avengers
description: In their first quarter-century the Avengers assemble, bring back Captain America, gain the Vision and fight the Kree and Skrull War. Bride of Ultron, the Korvac Saga, Wundagore, Under Siege and the assault on Olympus follow, from Stan Lee and Jack Kirby's earliest stories to Roger Stern and John Buscema's later ones. Gaps are deliberate.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
